fullDesc: Description: The OB2365 is a highly integrated current mode PWM control IC designed for offline flyback converter applications. fullDesc: Portable Energy Storage Spot Welder – Smart Auto-Trigger Circuit Board This spot welding machine circuit board can be used to weld 18650 / 26650 / 32650 and other lithium batteries . fullDesc: What It Is The S886-3A is a discrete semiconductor device manufactured by HARRIS, packaged in the standard TO-220 case. Based on its part-numbering (S8xx series) and package style, this is a Silicon Controlled Rectifier (SCR/Thyristor) — a 3-terminal switching device. What an SCR Does An SCR is a solid-state switch used to control power to a load. It's a four-layer (PNPN) thyristor with three terminals: an input control terminal (gate), an output terminal (anode), and a terminal common to both (cathode). Once triggered by a small gate current, it "latches" on and conducts current until the main current drops below a holding threshold — making it ideal for power switching and control circuits. fullDesc: Description Marked "T EL 3063 104V" on the package, this is Everlight Electronics' EL3063, a random-phase, zero-cross Triac driver optocoupler. It's a phototriac-output optoisolator that provides electrical isolation between a low-voltage control (LED) input and a high-voltage AC output stage, using an internal zero-cross detection circuit to switch the output only near the AC waveform's zero-crossing point — reducing electrical noise and inrush current stress when driving a triac. The device consists of a GaAs infrared LED optically coupled to a phototriac zero-voltage crossing detector, allowing it to directly or indirectly drive an external triac for controlling resistive and inductive AC loads such as solenoids, relays, and lamps, while providing high-voltage isolation between the control circuit and the mains-connected load. Key Specifications Type: Triac/SCR Output Optocoupler (Zero-Cross Triac Driver Photocoupler) Manufacturer: Everlight Electronics Co., Ltd.
